subject: GreenLeaf: incremental GPU migration + SLA buffer request
messages:
From: Marcus Drew <mdrew@greenleaf.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@greenleaf.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 usage and next steps for Dedicated pool

Priyom —

Thanks for the quick sync this morning. We attached the Q1 consumption export and a short note on a spike we saw in early February tied to a temporary batch-scoring run. Overall utilization is healthy, but two asks from my side as we approach renewal:

- Can we add a small pool of more recent A100-equivalent instances (we think it will materially reduce inference cost for our quantized models)?
- Given our growth forecast, we also want a 10% SLA headroom so customers never see throttling during weekly releases.

We’re evaluating commit size adjustments rather than a large immediate tranche top-up. Happy to hop on a call — Elena will coordinate times.

Cheers,
Marcus Drew
Head of Infrastructure, GreenLeaf AI

Attachment: greenleaf_usage_report_q1.csv (CSV, 450 KB)
From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Drew <mdrew@greenleaf.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q1 usage and next steps for Dedicated pool

Marcus — really useful data, thanks for sending. Quick read: your peak QPS aligns with what we expected during the Feb batch window, and steady-state token throughput looks ~18% above the committed baseline. Two immediate recommendations from my side:

1) Incremental SKU migration: introduce a small A100-equivalent slab (30 GPUs) dedicated for quantized workloads and set smart-routing to route short latency-critical requests there. This should lower per-token cost and tail latency for hot paths.

2) SLA buffer: add a 10% headroom buffer in the commit for an initial 3-month trial, with automatic monitoring and a canary policy that will trigger a review if buffer utilization exceeds 60% for three consecutive weeks.

I’ve looped Rishi to outline pricing impact and Hannah for renewal cadence and rollout ops. If that sounds right, I’ll send a proposal and SKU matrix.

Best,
Priyom Das
Principal Account Exec — Dedicated Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marcus Drew <mdrew@greenleaf.ai>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: GreenLeaf - incremental GPU migration + SLA buffer request

Marcus / team —

Thanks for the usage file. I ran a quick SKU-level projection and attached a proposal (proposed-sku-matrix.pdf). Highlights:

- 30x A100-equivalent (quantized-optimized) for hot routing: estimated incremental monthly commit $47,500 — 18% projected token-cost reduction on routed requests.
- 10% SLA headroom implemented as an elastic buffer that bills at a lower overage rate until we hit an agreed threshold; after 3 months we can either keep or reduce the buffer based on utilization.
- Migration cadence: staged over 2 weeks with a canary (5 GPUs), ramp to 30, and opt-in fallback to existing V100-class pool.

Operational notes: we will enable prefix KV caching for your frequent prompts (visible improvement with quantized models). We’ll also instrument a weekly report into a shared Drive folder.

Next steps: Marcus, if you approve the SKU mix I’ll prepare the amendment and get finance to generate a PO-ready quote. Hannah, can you block a short legal/ procurement slot to run through amendment terms?

—Rishi
Solution Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-sku-matrix.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)
From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Drew <mdrew@greenleaf.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GreenLeaf - incremental GPU migration + SLA buffer request

Marcus — great to see alignment. We’re good to move to an amendment with these guardrails:

- 90-day trial window for the 30-GPU slab with the 10% elastic buffer enabled.
- Weekly utilization dashboard (shared Drive) and an ops review at day 30 and day 75.
- Finance will apply standard commit discount tiers; overage when buffer used will be billed at the negotiated overage rate in the amendment.

Action items for GreenLeaf: please confirm the PO lead and target PO date so Finance can issue a quote. Once PO is in hand we’ll schedule the migration kickoff (suggested week of Apr 15).

Hannah Schmitt
Renewals Manager, Redwood Inference
